title: Gating the branch for silent learners
statement: Whether the follow-up for a learner who said nothing should gate progress at all is unsettled.
detail: A Grade 3 reading lesson has a branch whose job is to catch a child who said nothing. Its handover lists whether that branch should gate progress at all among the rulings still to be given: a recognition check there may be right, but gating on it is the open question.
against: A rule on record gates every check, since one a student can skip is decoration (gate-every-check).

evidence.quote: - **Whether the silent branch should gate progress at all.** Its job is to catch a child who said nothing; a recognition check there may be right, but gating on it is the open question.
